Widened purpose: registry membership. Exact edit: 'available in the asset registry' -> 'available for asset operations'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: registered identifiers to associated identifiers. Exact edit: 'registered at one site' -> 'associated with one site'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: registry-only information. Exact edit: 'registry details' -> 'asset details'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Widened purpose: observed-only measurement names. Exact edit: "measurement fields observed in an asset's telemetry stream" -> 'measurement fields associated with asset telemetry'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: assigned-only sensor relationship. Exact edit: 'sensor names assigned to an asset in the registry' -> 'sensor names associated with an asset in the registry'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: compact metadata subset. Exact edit: 'compact registry metadata' -> 'registry metadata'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: registered-only asset scope. Exact edit: 'Searches only assets registered at `site_name`.' -> 'Searches assets associated with `site_name`.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: one-asset stream scope. Exact edit: "an asset's telemetry stream" -> 'asset telemetry streams'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: chronological ordering requirement. Exact edit: 'one chronological page' -> 'one page'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: newest-only record selection in all purpose sentences. Exact edit: 'newest' -> 'available'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened the purpose by removing the every-sensor requirement, allowing summaries for subsets. Preserved the full-stream scan, non-null rules, offset rules and every Args/Returns line.
Widened purpose: one-or-all selection, allowing intermediate subsets. Exact edit: 'one or all measured sensors' -> 'measured sensors'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: JSON-only input format. Exact edit: 'a JSON file' -> 'a data file'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: catalog membership in the purpose. Exact edit: 'Return cataloged sensor types.' -> 'Return available sensor types.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: catalog membership in the purpose. Exact edit: 'Return cataloged asset classes and categories.' -> 'Return asset classes and associated categories.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: catalog membership in the purpose. Exact edit: 'Return cataloged failure modes by asset category.' -> 'Return failure modes grouped by asset category.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: present-time-only date/time. Exact edit: 'the current date time' -> 'the requested date time'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: English-only language. Exact edit: 'in English text' -> 'as readable text'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Widened 'the known failure modes' to 'failure-mode information' (no longer limited to stored modes). Revised after Sridhar's manual review on 2026-11-24: the earlier wording 'potential failure modes' implied generation or discovery.
Widened the purpose from a single asset class to multiple asset classes in one generation request. Preserved the no-database-write guarantee, stored-context rules, and every Args/Returns line.
Widened the purpose from a single asset class to multiple asset classes in one persistence request. Preserved existing-mode retention, merge/reporting semantics, and every Args/Returns line.

Widened purpose: closed filter-dimension enumeration. Exact edit: 'optional filters (site, status, asset, priority, dates)' -> 'optional filters (including site, status, asset, priority, dates)'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: requirement for both lookup identifiers. Exact edit: 'a single work order by number and site' -> 'a work order by number or site'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: child-parent-only task relationship. Exact edit: 'the child tasks of a parent work order' -> 'the related tasks of a work order'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: actual-only spending. Exact edit: 'Actual labor/material/service/tool cost breakdown' -> 'Labor/material/service/tool cost breakdown'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: estimated-versus-actual comparison baseline. Exact edit: 'Estimated vs actual hours and cost variance' -> 'Comparative hours and cost variance'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: single-site KPI aggregation. Exact edit: 'Site KPIs:' -> 'Operational KPIs:'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: non-terminal-only status. Exact edit: 'Scheduled (non-terminal) work orders' -> 'Scheduled work orders'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: assigned-only relationship. Exact edit: 'assigned to a given technician' -> 'associated with a given technician'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: CouchDB-only source in the purpose. Exact edit: 'from CouchDB' -> 'from available stores'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: fixed WAPPR initial status. Exact edit: '(status WAPPR)' -> '(initial status)'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: mutable-only attributes. Exact edit: 'mutable fields' -> 'recorded fields'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Widened the object scope from a work order to a maintenance record, retaining the singular operation and APPR transition. Removed the unsupported multiple-order claim; the input schema still identifies one work order.
Widened purpose: single-technician assignment. Exact edit: 'a technician' -> 'technical staff'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Widened purpose: mandatory actuals-and-resolution detail. Exact edit: 'with actuals and resolution' -> 'with completion details'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Widened the object from 'a work order' to 'a maintenance record' (a superset). Revised after Sridhar's manual review on 2026-11-24: the earlier wording 'multiple work orders' invented an unsupported batch capability.
Narrowed the purpose to decommissioning workflows; commissioning task T001 is a valid V0 use explicitly excluded by the MS purpose. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed the purpose to pump asset identifiers; unrestricted MAIN identifier tasks also request Chiller 6 and compressor mp_1. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: pump assets only. Exact edit: 'Return registry details for one asset.' -> 'Return registry details for one pump asset.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: temperature measurements only. Exact edit: "List measurement fields observed in an asset's telemetry stream." -> "List temperature measurement fields observed in an asset's telemetry stream.". Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: chiller assets only. Exact edit: 'List sensor names assigned to an asset in the registry.' -> 'List sensor names assigned to a chiller asset in the registry.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: compressor assets only. Exact edit: 'List assets at one site with compact registry metadata.' -> 'List compressor assets at one site with compact registry metadata.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: observed rather than installed sensor source. Exact edit: 'Find site assets by installed or measured sensor names.' -> 'Find site assets by measured sensor names.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: temperature streams only. Exact edit: "Inspect the size and timestamp span of an asset's telemetry stream." -> "Inspect the size and timestamp span of an asset's temperature telemetry stream.". Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: hourly sampling only. Exact edit: 'Return one chronological page of telemetry observations for an asset.' -> 'Return one chronological page of hourly telemetry observations for an asset.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: temperature telemetry only. Exact edit: 'Return the newest telemetry observation for an asset.' -> 'Return the newest temperature telemetry observation for an asset.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: temperature sensors only. Exact edit: 'Summarize non-null observation coverage for every measured sensor.' -> 'Summarize non-null observation coverage for every measured temperature sensor.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: single sensor, excluding all-field summaries. Exact edit: 'Compute numeric statistics for one or all measured sensors.' -> 'Compute numeric statistics for one measured sensor.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: calibration files only. Exact edit: 'Reads a JSON file, parses its content, and returns the parsed data.' -> 'Reads a calibration JSON file, parses its content, and returns the parsed data.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: temperature types only. Exact edit: 'Return cataloged sensor types.' -> 'Return cataloged temperature sensor types.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: rotating equipment only. Exact edit: 'Return cataloged asset classes and categories.' -> 'Return cataloged rotating-asset classes and categories.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: mechanical failures only. Exact edit: 'Return cataloged failure modes by asset category.' -> 'Return cataloged mechanical failure modes by asset category.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: inspection recording only. Exact edit: 'Provides the current date time as a JSON object.' -> 'Provides current date time as JSON for inspections.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: shift handovers only. Exact edit: 'Returns the current time in English text.' -> 'Returns current time in English for handovers.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: pump classes only. Exact edit: 'READ the known failure modes for an asset class.' -> 'READ the known failure modes for a pump asset class.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: compressor classes only. Exact edit: 'GENERATE a new or extended failure-mode list for an asset class.' -> 'GENERATE a new or extended failure-mode list for a compressor asset class.'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: complete/exhaustive lists only. Exact edit: 'WRITE failure modes for an asset class to the database.' -> 'WRITE exhaustive failure modes for an asset class to the database.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: open orders only. Exact edit: 'List work orders with optional filters' -> 'List open work orders with optional filters'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: approved orders only. Exact edit: 'Get a single work order by number and site.' -> 'Get an approved work order by number and site.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: corrective parent orders only. Exact edit: 'List the child tasks of a parent work order.' -> 'List the child tasks of a corrective parent work order.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: completed orders only. Exact edit: 'for a work order.' -> 'for a completed work order.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: preventive orders only. Exact edit: 'for a work order.' -> 'for a preventive work order.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: three-month reporting windows only. Exact edit: 'Site KPIs:' -> 'Quarterly site KPIs:'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: preventive work only. Exact edit: 'Scheduled (non-terminal) work orders' -> 'Scheduled preventive (non-terminal) work orders'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: open orders only. Exact edit: 'Work orders assigned' -> 'Open work orders assigned'. Args/Returns unchanged.

Narrowed purpose: bearing failures only. Exact edit: 'Read the FCC failure-code reference catalog from CouchDB.' -> 'Read the FCC bearing-failure-code reference catalog from CouchDB.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: preventive work only. Exact edit: 'Create a work order' -> 'Create a preventive work order'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: draft/unapproved orders only. Exact edit: 'on a work order.' -> 'on a draft work order.'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: corrective-maintenance work only. Exact edit: 'Approve a work order' -> 'Approve a CM work order'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: HVAC technicians only. Exact edit: 'Assign a technician' -> 'Assign an HVAC technician'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: corrective-maintenance work only. Exact edit: 'Close a work order' -> 'Close a CM work order'. Args/Returns unchanged.
Narrowed purpose: draft/unapproved orders only. Exact edit: 'Cancel a work order' -> 'Cancel a draft work order'. Args/Returns unchanged.
